question: What was the average number of vehicles in force across the four quarter-ends of 2025?
final_text:
The average number of vehicles in force across the four 2025 quarter-ends is **37,569.75**.

Quarter-end counts (in-force is a point-in-time measure, so each quarter shows its end-of-quarter value):

| Quarter-end | Vehicles in force |
|---|---|
| Q1 (31 Mar 2025) | 35,539 |
| Q2 (30 Jun 2025) | 36,722 |
| Q3 (30 Sep 2025) | 38,098 |
| Q4 (31 Dec 2025) | 39,920 |

Sum = 150,279; divided by 4 = 37,569.75.

ANSWER: 37569.75
